evidence.receipt: Retain authenticated receipt; bind principal, exact request/action/role/source generation, task mapping, profile, cohort and financial identity

ownership.trust_limit: Same-host cooperative ownership; not multi-host consensus or hostile-process isolation.

purpose: Connect genuine peer and controller coding dispatch to one cumulative spending authority; not permission to spend or an implemented execution contract.

registration_and_recovery.changed_contract: Prospective version and qualification required for changes to source, profile, cap, journal, roster or protocol
registration_and_recovery.durable_intent: Intent without recoverable result remains unknown; exact durable result may settle after lease expiry. Recovery never upgrades a pre-lock timestamp into current permission.
registration_and_recovery.fresh: Exact expected global cap/opening commitments, quiescent historical reservations/promotions, immutable cohort registration
registration_and_recovery.resume: Validate registered cohort and retained records; do not require original opening balance or mint a new cap
registration_and_recovery.saved_receipt: Exact successful historical receipt replay does not require a fresh lease and cannot authorize another invocation.
